items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And this time we had Waddell Gray with us, playing tenor. And Clark Terry, myself, Jimmy Lewis, Freddy Green.

ctx.x: And so, when we went out again, Freddie
was back in the band. We had the seven pieces, see. And this time we had Waddell Gray with us, playing tenor. And Clark Terry, myself, Jimmy Lewis, Freddy Green.
What kind of blowing was Clark doing at that time?
